tips.text: Join a big clan that already researched him and buy the blueprints; they stay yours if you leave.
On a solo clan, never build Barracks; it raises the clan tier and multiplies every research cost.
Plan the Dojo layout in a planner like dojoCAD before building so you do not tear rooms down.
Run Invasions for the Fieldron, Detonite Injectors and Mutagen Mass the research needs instead of farming samples.
Do not over-fund a Dojo; anything you put in is gone if you leave or disband.
A solo clan is easier than its reputation; the cost is mostly forma for rooms and Nezha's own research is small.
Nobody complains about getting Nezha; the only friction is not having a clan yet.
